label: caiso 21 bidir floor
definition: (PROBE — rejected, keeper stays caiso-import-cap-floor) Attempt to UNIFY the two 2026-06-23 CAISO threads: the bidir-intertie diurnal-shape fix (single signed WECC flow, both legs at the measured hub) PLUS the keeper's level levers ported onto it — the per-tranche delivered-cost basis now applied to the bidir import legs (line-loss on the positive hub + OATT wheeling, guarded so a negative hub can't break arbitrage-freeness) and the RA gas-commitment floor 0.80 — with interchange shaping + negative renewable offers. REGRESSES the keeper on every axis: 2024 neg-price hours 194 (keeper 815, actual ~800), net interchange -17.68 TWh (keeper -30.4, actual -32.4), p10 LMP $33.63 (keeper $1.40), mean $48.8 (keeper ~42, actual 35.8); diurnal corr +0.95 (2023) but only +0.09 (2024) and -0.12 (2025), i.e. the gas floor drags the bidir diurnal win back toward zero. ROOT CAUSE: the gas floor (forces gas online) and the delivery basis (raises import cost) BOTH suppress imports, so on the single-flow bidir node the model badly under-imports and the bidir export leg sells the midday surplus at the POSITIVE hub instead of crashing to negative — the negative tail the keeper relies on disappears, and the level levers prove ANTAGONISTIC with the bidir representation, not additive. Next: decompose (bidir+floor only / bidir+basis only) to find which lever is bidir-compatible; see results/calibration/NEXT-caiso-roadmap-2026-06-23.md.
